preMortem.scenario: tier-2 prefix heuristic over-flags too aggressively
preMortem.trigger: two unrelated files share a high-level dir prefix
preMortem.mitigation: tier-2 only flags when at least one side uses a trailing wildcard and shares a below-root prefix; classify as advisory, document over-flag is intentional-safe

preMortem.trigger: ScopeContractData has created paths in allowedCreate not in allowedModify
preMortem.mitigation: union allowedModify + allowedCreate and dedupe; smoke asserts both contribute

preMortem.scenario: grammar validator misses a malformed pattern
preMortem.mitigation: validator allowlists exactly literal | dir/* | dir/**; smoke asserts mid-path ** and bare * are rejected
